rv.q: Those expecting a traditional take on Charles Dickens' classic holiday perennial may be in for a shock at this dour production.
Mays brings a soft touch to a mammoth assignment, sliding gracefully between personas with little more than a head tilt or the slightest of vocal modulations.
In a move in line with increased efforts for better representation in the arts, two young disabled actors play Tiny Tim, Sebastian Ortiz and Jai Ram Srinivasan, both of whom have cerebral palsy.
The production continues to be worth watching, but the humbug curmudgeons in the audience might wonder if maybe another actor or two could be hired.
